feeds.title: Animal Defense League of Texas
feeds.description: The Animal Defense League was established in 1923 by a group of individuals, for the prevention of cruelty to animals. They rescue cats and dogs and provide them with medical treatment, nutrition, and shelter in a safe until they are matched with their forever families.

feeds.title: Humane Society of North Texas Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1905, the Humane Society of North Texas provides a variety of services to end animal cruelty & pet homelessness in North Texas. They work to find homeless pets, their forever homes. HSNT blog gives you useful information regarding pets' health, weather and safety tips, adoption events, and many more.

feeds.title: Healthy Pet Austin Blog
feeds.description: Healthy Pet Austin is a locally owned chain of premium pet stores which sell food, treats, toys, health, and grooming products for cats and dogs throughout Austin, Texas. Their Blog reveals some amazing tips and tricks for safety, health, food, grooming, exercise, and many more.

feeds.title: Two Hearts Pet Loss Center Blog
feeds.description: Coleen founded Two Hearts Pet Loss Center in 2009, to guide those people who also wish to provide death care services in their communities, as well as to be an educational resource in the pet grief discipline. They have all the information regarding pet loss and the grief that accompanies it.

feeds.title: Ducks of Providence
feeds.description: Ducks of Providence is all about pet ducks. You will learn everything you need about pet ducks, including raising ducks, duck care, duck food, building a coop, and more. Duck mom Melanie shares everything she has learned about ducks over the years. Based on her experiences, the focus is on pet ducks and small backyard flocks.

feeds.title: Houston Pet Talk
feeds.description: Houston PetTalk is a print and digital media that provides the number one source for all pet information, including events, news, pet care tips, human interest articles, local celebrities, and pet rescue.

feeds.title: Central Texas Animal Hospital Blog
feeds.description: Central Texas Animal Hospital has been providing high-quality medical vet care for cats and dogs since 1980. Our veterinary and Health Care Team consists of experienced professionals who are trained to provide the best vet care to your pets. CTAH Blog provides information regarding pet health, safety, grooming, and many more.

feeds.title: Operation Kindness Blog
feeds.description: Operation Kindness was started way back in 1976 by a group of volunteers. They planned to create a lifesaving shelter for homeless animals that had nowhere else to turn. In July 2022, Operation Kindness launched a new program that offers affordable, accessible veterinary services to under-resourced communities and shelters.Company's blog updates you on the latest Operation Kindness news, events, and press releases.

feeds.title: Dallas Pets Alive! Blog
feeds.description: DPA is an all-volunteer nonprofit working to rescue, rehab & re-home pets in the Dallas area. Its mission is to promote and provide the resources, education, and programs needed to eliminate the killing of companion animals. Dallas Pet Alive gives the option to not only adopt but foster pets and volunteer. To get all useful information about volunteering events and stories, you can visit their blog.

feeds.title: Star of Texas Veterinary Hospital Blog
feeds.description: Star of Texas Veterinary Hospital is a full-service veterinary practice in Austin, TX. Their team consists of animal lovers united by one purpose: caring for your pet like they were our own. They provide services like customizable exams, acupuncture, behavioral services, nutritional consults, preventative care, and pocket pets. Their blog offers information about pet behavior, general tips, chronic illness, and many more.

feeds.title: Texas Humane Heroes Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1979, Texas Humane Heroes is a No Kill, private, non-profit organization with dog and cat adoption centers. They enhance the lives of pets and people through adoption, availability of our low-cost spay/neuter and vaccinations as well as family-friendly community events. You will get all the helpful pet tips and lots of information to keep your pet healthy and help them live a long life in their blog.

feeds.title: VIP Pet Services Blog
feeds.description: VIP Pet Services is an award-winning service platform operating in the pet care industry for more than 17 years. The services provided include Pet Sitting, Dog Walking, Puppy services, Overnight Pet Services, Poop scooping, litter box services, and Dog training. The VIP Blog covers all the essential pet information about health, food, grooming, training, and some tips and tricks.

feeds.title: Janda Exotics Animal Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Janda Exotics Animal Ranch got licensed as a business in 2008, created by Ashley Duncan. They are exotic animal Reproduction Specialists. Their top goal is captive husbandry, the long-term physical and emotional care of our captive zoological species and farm animals. On their blog, you will learn about exotic animals, how to care for exotic pets, and behind the scenes in the animal community.

feeds.title: Valley Animal Hospital Blog
feeds.description: Valley Animal Hospital originally opened in San Juan in March 1946. They offer detailed examinations, behavioral counseling, microchipping, vaccinations, and wellness programs for your pets. They have their own Blog which helps you with Tips, Advice, and Helpful Information about taking care of your pets and their medical and health needs.

feeds.title: Petland Frisco Blog
feeds.description: Petland Frisco is a locally owned & operated pet store. Opened in 2003, Petland Frisco has been dedicated to matching families with the right pets. A Petland puppy is provided with significant veterinarian care and vaccinations before being placed in your home. Their blog offers information on the latest topics on dog health tips, puppy training, grooming, different breeds, and much more!

feeds.title: Primped Pooches Blog
feeds.description: Primped Pooches Mobile Dog Spa is locally owned and operated by Christin Boyte, a certified groomer with over ten years of experience. They provide a premium and affordable mobile dog grooming salon in Frisco, Allen, and McKinney, TX. You can visit their Primped Pooches Blog to get dog grooming tips and tricks to haircut ideas from certified dog groomers.

feeds.title: Ten West Vet Blog
feeds.description: Ten West Vet is a well-established, full-service, small animal veterinary hospital providing comprehensive medical, surgical, and dental care for pets in San Antonio. At Ten West, we also offer behavioral counseling, boarding, grooming, and microchip identification services. Their blog helps you with grooming, health, food, activities, and nurturing related tips for your pets.

feeds.title: Pet Doctor Blog
feeds.description: Pet Doctor is a full-service animal medical center that specializes in premium, affordable healthcare for the dogs and cats of Rockwall and Heath, TX. They have a blog which provides information about pet health care from expert veterinarians. Includes symptoms, prevention, behavior, and common conditions of pets.

feeds.title: Bayside Animal Hospital Blog
feeds.description: Bayside Animal Hospital is a full-service veterinary clinic that has been serving dogs and cats in Kemah, Texas since 2005. They provide services like wellness care and progressive use of laser therapy, DNA testing, and surgical procedures. Its Blog is about pet health, medical issues, activities, games, and tips for better pet parenting.

feeds.title: West Texas Veterinary Specialists Blog
feeds.description: West Texas Veterinary Specialists is a mobile specialty and tele consultation practice that serves West Texas Veterinarians. Our mobile specialty practice consists of a small animal internal medicine specialist who provides advanced diagnostics and therapeutics. WTVS Blog is about medical and health-related information.

feeds.title: In Stride Chiropractic Blog
feeds.description: In Stride Chiropractic helps pets live a better life with results-oriented chiropractic care. They find the root cause of what's going on and apply hands-on treatment to get your pet out of pain as fast as possible. Their blog talks about chiropractic misconceptions and a chiropractor's role in your pet's life along with some helpful fitness, health, weight loss, and diet tips.

feeds.title: Total Dog! Blog
feeds.description: Total Dog is a dog training solutions company and they believe that dog training should be based on tried-and-true techniques, tailored to your dog, and delivered with passion. You can check out their blog for informative dog training resources by professional dog trainers.

feeds.title: Austin Pets Alive Blog
feeds.description: Austin Pets Alive! is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping and rescuing animals. Austin Pets Alive provides the resources, education, and programs needed to eliminate the killing of companion animals. . The APA blog helps you discover Austin Pets Alive! behind the scenes-including impact stories from our community, APA! happenings, and letters from Dr. Jefferson.

feeds.title: Rebecca Creek Retrievers Blog
feeds.description: Rebecca Creek Retrievers is a breeding and training program for Health Tested and Guaranteed Standard Poodles and English Goldendoodles. It is an ideal place if you are looking for a healthy puppy that is raised with the utmost quality care. Their blog educates people about canine nutrition, training, and health care.

feeds.title: DogTipper
feeds.description: DogTipper is a positive place celebrating dog rescue! They help you celebrate life with your dog by including them in your daily life. The founders Paris Permenter, and John Bigley have written 35 travel and pet books. They help you with tips, homemade dog treat recipes, and year-round pet holidays. They also suggest amazing dog names and activities to do with your dog.

feeds.title: Heart of Texas Therapy Dogs Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2003 by Sheryll Barker and Barbara Wilson, Heart of Texas Therapy Dogs is a non-profit, all-volunteer organization that services the DFW area with therapy dogs. They conduct dog therapy sessions and provide a sense of comfort, peace, patience, ease, and love to their visitors. Their blog gives updates about the therapy sessions, events, fund-raisers, and healthcare information.

feeds.title: Jenna Regan Photography Blog
feeds.description: Jenna Regan Photography provides a professional pet photography service in Dallas Fort Worth. She is an award-winning, internationally published, full-time professional pet photographer focused on photographing pets such as dogs, cats, horses, and many more. Their Blog provides them with stories, photos, and updates about the life and work of Jenna Regan.

feeds.title: Texavet Blog
feeds.description: Texavet offers vaccinations, parasite control, and heartworm testing to dogs and cats in Texas communities. They also sell discounted flea control & heartworm prevention for families. Their blog updates us on the latest veterinary news and information from Texavet. The blog also provides articles on pet health, care, safety, training, grooming, and vaccinations.

feeds.title: Pet's Choice Animal Hospital Blog
feeds.description: Pet's Choice Animal Hospital is a full-service pet hospital offering a new and better veterinary experience for pets in Seguin and New Braunfels, TX. The services they provide include wellness & Prevention programs, sick pet treatment, diagnostics, surgical, daycare, and boarding. In the Hospital's blog, you will learn about the latest veterinary topics from the veterinarians and staff.

feeds.title: Creekside Pet Care Blog
feeds.description: Creekside Pet Care Center is a full-service 24/7 veterinary hospital with onsite grooming, daycare, and boarding services. Their veterinary services are available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, with a state-of-the-art emergency care facility. Their Blog is about pet diseases, symptoms, treatments, dog parks, activities, and many more similar subjects.

feeds.title: Petland Texas Blog
feeds.description: Since 1984, Petland Texas has been helping many families adopt new pets into their homes. Their primary goal is to make your new relationship with your pet the best that it can be. The PT Blog covers many topics, such as pet games, safety and travel tips, things to know about your puppy, and many more.

feeds.title: House Of Petz
feeds.description: House of Petz is a pet blog that provides information, know-how, and proven tips about raising pets from the most basic to the most advanced. We are a complete information source about pets, efficiently and neatly compiled in short, easy-to-read articles containing rich media like infographics, Images, and videos.

feeds.title: Texas Pet Company Blog
feeds.description: Texas Pet Company provides all-natural dog treats and supplements and accessories. They are a healthy alternative to processed, artificial, and chemical products for your pets. The Company Blog shares information about pet health, activities, cure and prevention of diseases, and gift ideas for pet owners.

feeds.title: K9 Connection Blog
feeds.description: K9 Connection is the premier dog training company in Texas. The founder of the company, Brian Cunningham, has over 30 years of experience and specializes in puppy training. Their Blog is a useful source of information on dog training. It is helpful for people looking for puppy training or dog behavioral solutions.

feeds.title: Texas Coalition for Animal Protection Blog
feeds.description: The Texas Coalition for Animal Protection (TCAP) is a nonprofit organization that supplies low-cost services to those qualified for assistance programs. They also provide subsidized savings on their clinic services. TCAP blog has all the necessary information regarding pet care, neuter centers, and health and grooming tips.

feeds.title: Vets of East Texas Blog
feeds.description: The Vets of East Texas serves the families of pets for more than a decade. They provide a wide range of services including preventative care, diagnostics, surgery, and emergency care, as well as more specialized services like dentistry, laser therapy, and weight management. They have a blog dedicated to maximizing your dog or cat's health and happiness.

feeds.title: Pet Vet Lubbock
feeds.description: Kingsgate Animal Hospital is a full-service animal hospital providing comprehensive pet healthcare services in Lubbock, TX. Our veterinarians offer a wide variety of medical, surgical, and dental services. The Hospital's Blog is about Holidays, Safety Tips, Fun Facts About Pets, Pet Care in the Fall, and much more intriguing information.

feeds.title: Safari Veterinary Care Centers Blog
feeds.description: Safari Veterinary Care Centers is your one-stop solution for all your pet's needs. In 1984, Dr. Garner founded Safari with the idea of creating a veterinary hospital. They offer many services as Veterinary Dental Services, Regenerative Stem Cell Therapy, Pet Animal Rehabilitation, and many more. Their blog contains updates from their center, along with pet boarding, pet sitting, and health and safety tips.

feeds.title: Your Pet Planet
feeds.description: Your Pet Planet has a team of dedicated bloggers who are animal lovers to the core. So naturally, they have all the necessary knowledge of pets and domesticated animals. We aim to bring positive change through the blog, to increase the overall number of pet enthusiasts in the world - and also to provide the best possible information available to existing pet owners.
